mechanism_narrative: A higher unemployment rate directly signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces corporate earnings growth expectations and depresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate below 4.5% indicates an active monetary easing cycle, which reduces the cost of capital for corporations and stimulates economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS falls below 4.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate and decline in industrial production signals a severe economic contraction, which triggers a flight to safety and negative equity returns, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises >0.2pp and INDPRO falls >0.5% in the prior month, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures signals an overheating economy that prompts central bank tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 40% of instances during late-cycle expansions when RSAFS is above its 12-month moving average, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window in late-cycle expansions.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production directly reflects weakening economic activity, which reduces corporate revenue growth prospects and depresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0%, it signals a severe labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate and decline in real personal consumption expenditures signals a dual shock to the labor market and consumer demand, which triggers a recessionary spiral and negative equity returns, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises >0.2pp and RSAFS falls >0.5% in the prior month, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery phase, a low federal funds rate (below 2.0%) indicates an accommodative monetary policy that supports economic rebound and equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances during post-shock recovery periods when FEDFUNDS is below 2.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
